name: analytics
title: Analytics
description: A typed event catalog, an Analytics service with console, PostHog and Analytics Engine adapters, the browser helpers that send page views and web vitals, and /api/events.

ANALYTICS_PROVIDER.description: Where analytics events go: none, console, posthog or analytics-engine

POSTHOG_KEY.description: PostHog project API key, used when ANALYTICS_PROVIDER is posthog

setup.description: To send events to PostHog, create a PostHog project and copy its project API key. Then run `bun run setup --env staging --var ANALYTICS_PROVIDER=posthog`, and again with `--env production`: each asks for POSTHOG_KEY and uploads it to Cloudflare. Then commit wrangler.jsonc and deploy.
